notes.name: presenting_complaint_hpi
notes.text: ETU BH Matale 0640hrs. 68M BROUGHT DEAD by relatives. Hx from son: c/o chest pain & sweating ~2hrs at home, then collapsed.

notes.name: past_medical_history
notes.text: k/c/o IHD 5 yrs, on aspirin 75mg, ISMN 30mg.

notes.name: clinical_examination
notes.text: No pulse. No resp effort. Pupils fixed & dilated.

notes.name: cause_of_death_information
notes.text: Pronounced dead 0650hrs. Inform police for inquest? - discussed with JMO, natural death suspected.
